title: Abeon notification preferences
description: A user's delivery preferences, owned by AbeonUnified and served at `/api/v1/notifications/preferences` (ADR-0028). Per user, across organisations, like the feed. A rule turns a channel on or off for one notification type, or for every type with `*`; a specific type wins over `*`. A channel the emitter did not request is never added. `in_app` is not configurable: the feed is the record.
